about_the_game:
Hollow Ascent is a third-person action RPG set in a dark fantasy city overrun by the undead. Trapped within its gothic urban scenery, you must scavenge, fight to survive, and uncover fragments of a forgotten past.

Death is never the end — death binds you to the city, and escape may be the only way to save yourself

Key Features

  • Action RPG – Engage in challenging third-person battles with weapons, armour, potions and spell

  • Directional Combat – Attack and defend with precision. Your strikes, blocks, and parries can land where you want them to.

  • Gothic scenery: Explore an urban environment with an ominous gothic style

  • Dark fantasy horror – Navigate a city where atmosphere, fear, and danger are ever present.

  • Scavenge – Enter abandoned houses, temples and other structures, clear them of enemies, and loot them for weapons, supplies, and hidden lore.

  • Cycle of resurrection – What doesn't kill makes you stronger, or weaker. Death pulls you back, forcing you to adapt to changed enemies and new loot

  • Exploration-driven storytelling – Piece together the city’s history, your forgotten past, and the mysteries that linger.

  • Myterious narrative – Experience a story shaped by exploration, danger, and discovery, where not everything is as it seems.

Story

The city is alive with decay. Its streets are crawling with the restless dead, abandoned buildings whisper forgotten secrets, and shadows stretch across crumbling towers. You awaken with a fragmented mind and memories — the need to restore yourself is the only certainty

To endure, you must clear the streets of undead and take what remains. Weapons, supplies, and fragments of knowledge, but danger lurks behind every door.

Death is not a release. Each fall brings resurrection, pulling you back into a city which may not be exactly as you remember. Awake stronger, wiser, and closer to discovering what manipulates the undead that stalk its streets.

Combat is deliberate and deadly. Engage zombies, skeletons, and other horrors with melee weapons, bows, and spells — or rely on stealth and cunning.

Exploration is your guide. Some secrets are hidden behind locked gates, others guarded by relentless foes. Defeat them to push deeper into the city… and closer to the truth of your own past.

The story is shaped by the clues you uncover, the buildings you clear, and the enemies you confront. Only those who dare to delve deeper will glimpse the bigger picture — and find a path to freedom.

content_descriptors.notes: Realistic dark fantasy combat with blood, injuries, and character deaths. Includes enemies like zombies and skeletons that may grab or harass the player. Setting is dark and contains depictions of violence, war and executions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
